content.user_title: Draft and Publish Clear GitHub Issues
content.value_statement: Unclear issue requests create rework, duplicates, and weak acceptance criteria. This skill produces reviewed GitHub issues with consistent structure and controlled publishing.
actual_capabilities: Classifies requests as bugs, features, user stories, or tasks.
Uses repository issue templates before bundled fallback templates.
Runs one focused duplicate search and surfaces matching issues.
Drafts issue content, labels, assignees, types, and dependency plans.
Creates or updates GitHub issues only after explicit user confirmation.
Adds, removes, and reprioritizes sub-issues when requested.
limitations: Requires a target repository and enough issue context before publishing.
GitHub mutations require a configured MCP server, authentication, and repository permissions.
Does not implement code changes or author pull requests.
Cannot publish the first draft without explicit user confirmation.

use_cases.title: Shape a feature request
use_cases.description: Convert a product idea into scoped outcomes, acceptance criteria, labels, and a reviewable GitHub issue.

use_cases.title: Report a reproducible bug
use_cases.description: Organize symptoms, reproduction steps, environment details, severity, and expected behavior before publishing.

use_cases.title: Plan linked delivery tasks
use_cases.description: Decompose work into ordered tasks, identify blockers, and prepare parent and sub-issue relationships.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a basic issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a GitHub issue for [idea]. Use repository [owner/repo], ask for missing details, and wait for approval before publishing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a first issue from a short request.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a bug report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a bug issue for [problem] in [owner/repo]. Capture reproduction steps, environment, impact, expected behavior, and possible duplicates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn an observed defect into a testable report.

prompt_templates.title: Build a user story
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a user story for [user need]. Define role, workflow, scenarios, acceptance criteria, boundaries, dependencies, labels, and assignee intent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a product story with verifiable outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan and link tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Stress-test [objective], then decompose it into ordered GitHub tasks. Identify unresolved contracts, blockers, issue types, and proposed sub-issue links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create an advanced delivery plan across related issues.

output_examples.input: Draft a bug for intermittent login failures after session renewal.
output: Title: Login sometimes fails after session renewal
Includes reproduction steps, environment questions, expected behavior, impact, and duplicate-check results.

output_examples.input: Turn the reporting export idea into a feature issue.
output: Defines supported formats, scope boundaries, measurable acceptance criteria, dependencies, labels, and assignee intent.

output_examples.input: Split the notification redesign into linked tasks.
output: Orders discovery, contract alignment, implementation, and validation tasks.
Lists proposed parent, sub-issue, and blocker relationships for review.

best_practices: Provide the target repository, desired outcome, and important constraints.
Review title, body, labels, assignee, issue type, and relationships before approval.
Resolve architecture assumptions before creating parallel implementation tasks.
anti_patterns: Do not request publication before reviewing the generated draft.
Do not use vague acceptance criteria that cannot be verified.
Do not create contradictory or circular issue relationships.

faq.question: Can this skill publish GitHub issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create or update issues through GitHub MCP after explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: Does it support repository issue templates?
faq.answer: Yes. Repository templates take priority over the bundled fallback templates.

faq.question: Can it detect duplicate issues?
faq.answer: It runs one focused GitHub issue search and presents relevant matches before drafting or publishing.

faq.question: Can it manage sub-issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It can add, remove, or reprioritize sub-issues when the user requests relationship changes.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: GitHub operations require a configured GitHub MCP server, valid authentication, and sufficient repository permissions.

faq.question: Will it modify code or pull requests?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on issue drafting, review, metadata, publishing, and issue relationships.
